notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Sakashima the Impostor on the battlefield as a copy of Lonis.
description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and Sakashima the Impostor's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Sakashima the Impostor.
Sakashima the Impostor's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.
